notes:
Summary: Ironbark is evaluating a Private VPC deployment for production chat + document-search with strict audit logging requirements. Primary drivers: financial compliance, forensics capability, and long-term retention for regulatory audits.

Audit logging specifics requested by IRB (customer paraphrase):
- 'We need everything that touches PII to be auditable and exportable to our Splunk cluster.'
- SIEM export: support for syslog (TCP/TLS), HTTPS JSON webhook, and S3-delivered batches (SSE-KMS). Prefer syslog/TLS for real-time alerts; S3 for cold storage archives.
- Log schema: asked for structured JSON events with fields: request_id, trace_id, timestamp_iso, account_id, user_id (hashed), actor_type, model_id, model_variant, route, prompt_hash (salted), token_count_input, token_count_output, latency_ms, response_code, kv_cache_hit, cache_prefix_id, decision_policy (fallback/route), storage_reference (if persisted), redaction_status, pii_flag, geo_region, egress_cost_usd. Also field-level versioning (schema_version).
- Access logs: admin console actions (who changed rollout/policy), API key usage logs (key_id, operation, source_ip, user_agent), and service-to-service TLS certificate events.
- Retention: they proposed dual-tier retention: raw JSON events retained 365 days (hot) and immutable audit archives retained 7 years (cold). Legal wants ability to mark subsets for 10-year retention if subpoenaed. Need WORM-style archives or signed manifests.
- KMS: must integrate with customer-managed AWS KMS (CMK) or HSM for envelope encryption of persisted artifacts and archives. Key rotation every 90 days acceptable; must support key rotation without breaking existing archive decryption.
- Redaction & PII: Redwood must support runtime redaction hooks and an option to only log prompt hashes for PII-sensitive prompts (customer wants both modes: full-logging for internal users, hashed-only for production).
- Export latency & throughput targets: near-real-time for security events (<10s to SIEM) and batch export for bulk archives (S3 hourly).

Current asks from IRB:
- Provide a sample 1M-event JSON log export (anonymized) and a mapping doc for Splunk ingest (CEF + JSON examples).
- Confirm retention configuration UI and API (how admins set per-namespace retention).
- Legal: draft of audit retention SLA and e-discovery process.
